latest_release.name: Release v1.23.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* [Bug]: iOS chat input stays tall after sending a multi-line message by @pocketpal-dev-team[bot] in https://github.com/a-ghorbani/pocketpal-ai/pull/1052
* [Bug]: Search download over a text-only preset skips vision by @pocketpal-dev-team[bot] in https://github.com/a-ghorbani/pocketpal-ai/pull/1053
* fix(e2e): don't report runs where every test skipped as passed by @alicangunduz in https://github.com/a-ghorbani/pocketpal-ai/pull/1054
* [Feat]: Local OpenAI-compatible API server (POC) by @pocketpal-dev-team[bot] in https://github.com/a-ghorbani/pocketpal-ai/pull/990
* [Bug]: Imported chats lose assistant replies by @pocketpal-dev-team[bot] in https://github.com/a-ghorbani/pocketpal-ai/pull/1058
* [Bug]: Fix OpenCL GPU load crash on Adreno 730 (Snapdragon 8 Gen 1) by @pocketpal-dev-team[bot] in https://github.com/a-ghorbani/pocketpal-ai/pull/1049
* [Bug]: Validate paths from imported pals and chats by @pocketpal-dev-team[bot] in https://github.com/a-ghorbani/pocketpal-ai/pull/1012
* iOS: unique whisper Metal library and device-slice CI scans by @pocketpal-dev-team[bot] in https://github.com/a-ghorbani/pocketpal-ai/pull/1023

## New Contributors
* @alicangunduz made their first contribution in https://github.com/a-ghorbani/pocketpal-ai/pull/1054

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/a-ghorbani/pocketpal-ai/compare/v1.22.1...v1.23.0
